issue_context.title: Feature request: treat Memory/ReadOnlyMemory<T> as T[] in System.Text.Json
issue_context.body:
EDIT: see https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/86442#issuecomment-1605362904 for API proposal.
Original Proposal

I would like System.Text.Json to serialize/deserialize `Memory/ReadOnlyMemory` using the same logic as it uses for `T[]`. This implies: * `Memory` should be base64-encoded just like `byte[]` is * `Memory` should be serialized as appropriate for the type `FooBar`, same as `FooBar[]` would. The main motivation is that I have an array from `ArrayPool.Shared`, which can have space for more items than I actually need. To serialize only a segment of the array, I would like to use `Memory` to identify only use "used" part of the array.
